title: Soft!
text: Soft!. My daughter has a part time roommate who is allergic to cats. She recently got 2 kittens. She's taking measures to help keep the apartment better for the roommate. She keeps his room shut all the time. There are hardwoods throughout. She is using an air purifier and now she has a cover to keep on the couch when he's around. It can be washed between the roommates stays or as needed. It's nice looking and very soft. It fits the couch pretty well. She's hoping it works for the roommate!
